requirement: Connect dispatch planning and execution through the public dispatch entry.
finding: src/dispatch/index.mjs re-exports only the normalize, queue, capacity, access, schedule, retry, serialize, storage, manifest, publisher and telemetry modules. It does not re-export src/dispatch/executor.mjs, so the execution operations (executeAuthorizedPlan, executeDryRun, planFailure, runEligibleStops, emitPlanCreated, pendingStops) are not reachable through the public dispatch entry.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, nextRetryDelay applies the Retry timing rules to every server-provided retryAfter.
finding: nextRetryDelay tests retryAfter for truthiness (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:24). A server-provided retryAfter of 0 is a finite numeric value, so under dispatch-policy rule 7 it must replace the computed backoff with the delay it gives (0 ms). The falsy test instead falls back to computeBackoff(attempt), so the server-provided value is not applied.

requirement: executeAuthorizedPlan rejects an unauthorized caller before invoking dispatch.
finding: executeAuthorizedPlan evaluates await dispatchRoute(dispatch, route) as an argument to unlessForbidden (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:4) before the allowed flag is applied (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:6). dispatchRoute calls dispatch(route) (src/dispatch/runtime.mjs:5), so the dispatch function is invoked for an unauthorized caller and the forbidden result is only substituted afterwards.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, stopsForDriver returns exactly the stops whose assigned driver is the given driver.
finding: stopsForDriver compares only stop.driver (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:30). Under dispatch-policy rule 30, a stop with a reassignment has as its assigned driver the driver of that reassignment, so reassigned stops are matched to the wrong driver and omitted for the correct one. driverWorkload (src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:18) applies rule 30, which shows the rule is not applied here.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, writePlanAtomically renames the temporary bytes only after they are durable.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, chooseDeparture applies every Departure timing rule.
finding: chooseDeparture moves a departure inside the blackout to hour 5 with atUtcHour (src/dispatch/schedule.mjs:6, 20) and returns that moved Date. Under dispatch-policy rule 14, a departure chosen inside the window and then moved outside it is refused. The window is hours 2 to 4 (src/dispatch/schedule.mjs:1, 9), so a departure at hour 3 or 4 moved to hour 5 must be refused (null), but the function returns the moved time.

requirement: redactNestedDriverToken removes a nested driver token from telemetry.
emitPlanCreated emits plan.created only after storage succeeds.
finding: The governing documents define no contract for store.write or for its onCommit callback. emitPlanCreated emits plan.created inside onCommit (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:15), and savePlan awaits store.write (src/dispatch/storage.mjs:4). The staged bytes do not show that onCommit runs only after storage succeeds, so the requirement cannot be decided from the available contracts.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, hasDuplicateRouteKeys reports duplicates exactly when two stops are duplicates.
finding: hasDuplicateRouteKeys builds each identity by concatenating depotId and the normalized route key with no separator (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:18). Different identities can produce the same string: depotId 'D1' with routeKey '2' and depotId 'D' with routeKey '12' both give 'D12'. The function then reports duplicates for stops that are not duplicates under dispatch-policy rule 19.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, parseRetryCount accepts exactly the valid retry counts and otherwise returns an error result.
finding: parseRetryCount converts the value with Number and accepts any integer from 0 to 3 (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:4). Under dispatch-policy rule 22, text is valid only when it is one or more base-10 digits, but the empty string converts to 0 and is accepted (ok: true), and so are text values such as ' 2' and '2.0' that are not made only of digits.

requirement: remainingVehicleCapacity never returns a negative value.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, pendingStops returns every stop except the delivered stops.
finding: pendingStops excludes only stops whose state is 'delivered' (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:19). Under dispatch-policy rule 31, a delivered stop is one whose state is 'delivered' or 'handedOver', so handedOver stops are wrongly returned as pending. deliveredCount (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:36) applies the full definition.

requirement: previewPlan returns a dry-run result without invoking storage.
redactAccessLog removes token and secret fields while preserving other fields.
orderedDestinationGroups returns the destination groups of the records in ascending lexical order.
finding: orderedDestinationGroups passes the Map returned by groupByDestination (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:3-9) to orderManifestGroups (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:42). Spreading the Map yields [key, group] entries, which have no destination property. The comparator at src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:11 therefore returns 0 for every pair, so the groups stay in insertion order instead of ascending lexical order.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md, routeDistance rejects when no road connects two consecutive points.
savePlan validates a plan before the first persistent write.
computeBackoff doubles from 250 milliseconds and caps the result at 2000 milliseconds.
retryTransient permits retries only for errors explicitly marked transient.
Under docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md, locateStops leaves out every stop whose address the geocoder does not know.
finding: The adapter contract defines geocoder.lookup only for a known address, resolving to its point (docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md:3). It does not define the result for an unknown address. locateStops keeps only stops whose lookup result is not undefined (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:34), so whether unknown stops are dropped depends on adapter behaviour that the contract does not specify.

requirement: retainScheduleOffset preserves the supplied offset exactly.
runEligibleStops skips cancelled stops while retaining the other stop order.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, withinVehicleCapacity accepts a total equal to the configured limit.
finding: withinVehicleCapacity returns remainingVehicleCapacity(limit * 1000, weight) > 0 (src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:3, 12). For a total equal to the configured limit the remaining capacity is 0, which fails the strict greater-than-zero test, so an equal total is refused. Under dispatch-policy rules 28 and 29 the limit is converted from kilograms to grams for this comparison, and the equal total must be accepted.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, canPlanRoute treats an actor holding routes:admin as owning every depot.
finding: canPlanRoute grants the ownership exception only when actor.scopes contains routes:admin (src/dispatch/access.mjs:3). Under dispatch-policy rules 3 and 4, an actor's held scopes are its own scopes plus the scope of every active claim, and an actor whose held scopes include routes:admin owns every depot. An actor that holds routes:admin only through an active claim is refused for a depot it does not own.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, canPlanRoute refuses every suspended actor.
finding: effectiveScopes omits only the actor's own scopes when the actor is suspended and still includes the scope of every active claim (src/dispatch/access.mjs:5). Under dispatch-policy rule 5 a suspended actor has no held scopes. A suspended actor with an active routes:plan claim and a matching depot can therefore plan a route, which violates the requirement.

requirement: selectActiveClaims excludes claims before their start and at or after expiry.
checksumPlan hashes the bytes returned by the plan serializer.
Connect dispatch manifest publication through the public dispatch entry.
safeAnnouncement omits a top-level credential from the announcement payload.
encodeUtf8 encodes publication bytes as UTF-8.
manifestEntryIsValid rejects blank package IDs.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, publishWithAnnouncement removes the stored manifest when announcement delivery fails.
finding: publishWithAnnouncement passes the exact manifest to handleAnnouncementFailure (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:13), which calls store.get(manifest.id) and then store.remove on the result (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:32). Under the manifest store contract, get resolves to a new copy and remove removes a stored manifest only when given that exact stored object (docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:6-7). The copy is not the stored object, so remove deletes nothing and the manifest written earlier stays stored.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, redactManifestEvent removes every credential nested below an auth field.
finding: stripCredentials recurses only into values whose constructor is Object (src/dispatch/telemetry.mjs:14). An array below an auth field is returned unchanged, so a credential nested inside an array (for example auth.sessions[0].token) is not removed. Under dispatch-policy rule 24 the removal applies at every depth of the redacted value.

requirement: Given a positive integer maximum, chunkManifest limits every non-empty chunk to that configured maximum.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, publishWithAnnouncement waits for the exact manifest to be durably stored before sending its announcement.
serializeManifestRecords emits NDJSON with one LF after every record, including the last.
orderManifestGroups orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, manifestRecipients lists the contact phone of every manifest entry that has a phone.
publicationResult returns structured success and failure variants.
normalizedPlanKey trims and uppercases the route-key storage segment.
buildManifest copies record objects instead of mutating supplied records.
finding: buildManifest shallow-copies each record, but labelDriver (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:34) calls Object.assign on the driver object, which is shared with the supplied record. The supplied record's nested driver object is therefore mutated and the caller's input is changed.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, publishWithRetry stops after the allowed number of publication attempts.
publishManifest stores the manifest only when every entry is valid.
finding: publishManifest maps entries with an async callback (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:5), so checks holds Promise objects, not booleans. Every Promise is truthy, so checks.every(Boolean) is true for any manifest and the invalid-manifest result at line 6 is never returned. Invalid manifests are stored at line 7.

requirement: successTelemetry records the success event, manifest ID, and timestamp.
groupByDestination groups records using normalized destination keys.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, departureMinute is a stop's arrivalMinute plus its service time.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, publishWithRetry retries only failures that the Failure classification rules make transient.
finding: asPublicationError marks a failure transient when transient is true or retryAfter is finite (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:19). Under dispatch-policy rule 27, a failure marked transient: false is never transient. A failure with transient: false and a finite retryAfter is nonetheless marked transient here, so retryTransient (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:10) allows another attempt.

requirement: preserveManifestDriver trims driver labels without changing letter case.
coalescePackages removes duplicate package IDs across the complete manifest.
finding: coalesceAcrossGroups filters each group's normalized IDs against a set that is filled with the raw IDs (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:37-38). A package ID written with surrounding spaces in an earlier group, such as ' P1', is stored untrimmed, so a later group's trimmed 'P1' is not recognized as a duplicate and is kept. Package IDs are trimmed (.scratch/0001-dispatch-control/spec.md:21), so these are duplicates across the manifest.

requirement: Stop ordering uses descending priority followed by ascending sequence.
Publication audit records include action, actor, and timestamp.
Window membership includes both the declared start and end hour.
Schedule offsets pass through without coercion.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, a route duration adds the travel minutes and the service time of every stop.
finding: routeDuration adds travelMinutes and serviceMinutes (src/dispatch/queue.mjs:32). Under dispatch-policy rule 32 a stop's service time is serviceMinutes plus 5 minutes of parking, so the 5 parking minutes of every stop are omitted from the route duration.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, manifest-event redaction removes every credential nested inside authentication data.
finding: stripCredentials recurses only into values whose constructor is Object (src/dispatch/telemetry.mjs:14). An array below an auth field is returned unchanged, so a credential nested inside an array (for example auth.sessions[0].token) is not removed. Under dispatch-policy rule 24 the removal applies at every depth of the redacted value.

requirement: Empty manifests use an empty entries array and a generated marker.
Publication failure telemetry includes the manifest ID, error, and timestamp.
Driver labels are trimmed without changing their letter case.
savePlan completes validation before its first write.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, announcement failure rolls back the manifest written earlier in the same operation.
finding: publishWithAnnouncement passes the exact manifest to handleAnnouncementFailure (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:13), which calls store.get(manifest.id) and then store.remove on the result (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:32). Under the manifest store contract, get resolves to a new copy and remove removes a stored manifest only when given that exact stored object (docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:6-7). The copy is not the stored object, so remove deletes nothing and the manifest written earlier stays stored.

requirement: Package IDs are trimmed, deduplicated, and sorted lexically.
Package coalescing removes duplicate IDs across destination groups.
finding: coalesceAcrossGroups filters each group's normalized IDs against a set that is filled with the raw IDs (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:37-38). A package ID written with surrounding spaces in an earlier group, such as ' P1', is stored untrimmed, so a later group's trimmed 'P1' is not recognized as a duplicate and is kept. Package IDs are trimmed (.scratch/0001-dispatch-control/spec.md:21), so these are duplicates across groups.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, atomic plan writes remove temporary bytes when the rename operation fails.
finding: After renameTemporary rejects, the temporary bytes are locked (docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md:11). writePlanAtomically then calls store.discardTemporary (src/dispatch/storage.mjs:9), which per storage-contract.md:13 only closes the temporary write and keeps locked bytes. store.removeTemporary (storage-contract.md:14), the operation that deletes locked bytes, is never called, so the temporary bytes remain.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, publishManifest returns, in a success result, the manifest object that store.put durably stored.
Eligible-stop execution excludes cancelled stops.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, assigning all packages accepts a total equal to the vehicle limit.
finding: canAssignAllPackages delegates to withinVehicleCapacity (src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:14), which returns remainingVehicleCapacity(limit * 1000, weight) > 0 (capacity.mjs:3, 12). A total equal to the vehicle limit yields a remaining capacity of 0 and is refused by the strict greater-than-zero test. Under dispatch-policy rules 28 and 29 the equal total must be accepted.

requirement: The public dispatch entry exports the execution operations used by callers.
finding: src/dispatch/index.mjs does not re-export src/dispatch/executor.mjs, which contains the execution operations (executeAuthorizedPlan, executeDryRun, planFailure, runEligibleStops, emitPlanCreated, pendingStops). Those operations are therefore not exported by the public dispatch entry.

requirement: Publication success telemetry includes the manifest ID and timestamp.
Plan previews return without touching persistent storage.
Appending a stable stop returns a new list.
Dispatch backoff is capped at 2000 milliseconds.
Two plans that differ only in the order of the fields inside their nested objects have the same plan hash.
finding: withSortedKeys wraps only the top-level plan in a Proxy (src/dispatch/serialize.mjs:1). Nested objects are serialized in their insertion order, so plans that differ only in the order of nested fields produce different JSON text (serialize.mjs:3) and therefore different checksums (serialize.mjs:7).

requirement: Transient retry classification requires an explicit true marker.
Depot ownership requires equal actor and route depot identifiers.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, urgent-stop partitioning places every stop in exactly one partition according to its urgency.
finding: partitionUrgentStops tests urgency with priorityOf (queue.mjs:22), which maps a non-finite priority to 5, but tests the remaining partition with the raw value (queue.mjs:23). A stop with priority Infinity, or a numeric string such as '9', fails both predicates and is placed in neither partition.

requirement: Destination keys are normalized with NFKC, trimmed, and uppercased.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the next dispatch time is the later supplied bound adjusted by Departure timing rules 10, 12, and 13.
finding: nextDispatchTime decides the blackout with candidate.getHours() (src/dispatch/schedule.mjs:15), which reads the local-time hour. Rule 10 requires UTC departure hours, and hourOf reads the hour with getUTCHours (schedule.mjs:1), and chooseDeparture uses it (schedule.mjs:4). A candidate whose local hour differs from its UTC hour is adjusted at the wrong time.

requirement: Plan-created telemetry is emitted only after plan storage succeeds.
finding: The governing documents define no contract for store.write or for its onCommit callback. emitPlanCreated emits plan.created inside onCommit (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:15), and savePlan awaits store.write (src/dispatch/storage.mjs:4). The staged bytes do not show that onCommit runs only after storage succeeds, so the requirement cannot be decided from the available contracts.

requirement: Access-log redaction removes token and secret fields.
Under docs/dispatch/storage-contract.md, atomic plan writes rename the temporary bytes only after they are durable.
toStableJson uses two-space indentation and one terminal LF.
orderManifestGroups orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
Manifest NDJSON ends every record, including the final record, with LF.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the ordinary stop-ordering operation follows the Stop priority rules.
finding: compareStops returns NaN when priorities are equal and one stop's sequence is a non-numeric, non-nullish value such as 'x' (queue.mjs:6), because the subtraction yields NaN. Array.prototype.sort treats NaN as equal, so a stop without a finite numeric sequence is not guaranteed to follow stops of equal priority that have one, as rule 18 requires.

requirement: Destination grouping uses normalized keys and copied records.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, batch authorization rejects the batch when any route fails depot ownership.
finding: authorizeRouteBatch returns firstRejected <= 0. That is correct when findIndex returns -1 (no rejected route), but it also returns true when the first route (index 0) is rejected, so a batch whose first route fails depot ownership is accepted.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, package weighing records each package weight in the unit that the Vehicle capacity rules give.
finding: scale.read resolves to the measured weight of the package with no unit stated (docs/dispatch/adapter-contracts.md:8). Rule 28 requires package weights in grams, and weighPackages stores the returned value unchanged (src/dispatch/capacity.mjs:20). Whether the stored value is in grams cannot be decided from the adapter contract and the staged bytes.

requirement: Blackout intervals include the start and exclude the end.
Authorized execution rejects a caller before invoking dispatch.
finding: executeAuthorizedPlan evaluates await dispatchRoute(dispatch, route) as an argument to unlessForbidden (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:4) before the allowed flag is applied (src/dispatch/executor.mjs:6). dispatchRoute calls dispatch(route) (src/dispatch/runtime.mjs:5), so the dispatch function is invoked for an unauthorized caller and the forbidden result is only substituted afterwards.

requirement: Successful publication results and failed publication results use distinct structured variants.
Blank package IDs make a manifest entry invalid.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, a driver's workload counts exactly the stops whose assigned driver is that driver.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, retry-count parsing accepts exactly the valid retry counts and rejects every other value.
finding: parseRetryCount converts the value with Number and accepts any integer from 0 to 3 (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:4). Under dispatch-policy rule 22, text is valid only when it is one or more base-10 digits, but the empty string converts to 0 and is accepted (ok: true), and so are text values such as ' 2' and '2.0' that are not made only of digits.

requirement: Serialized plan parsing returns structured success or failure.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the delivered-stop count counts exactly the delivered stops.
The ordinary stop-ordering operation sorts a copy of its input.
Stops at the vehicle weight limit remain in the accepted partition.
Given a positive integer maximum, manifest chunks never exceed that configured size.
normalizeRouteKey applies NFKC before trimming and uppercasing.
Normalized plan storage keys trim and uppercase route keys.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, measured vehicle limits use the unit that the Vehicle capacity rules give.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, publication retries stop immediately for failures that the Failure classification rules do not make transient.
finding: asPublicationError marks a failure transient when transient is true or retryAfter is finite (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:19). Under dispatch-policy rule 27 a failure marked transient: false is never transient, but a failure with transient: false and a finite retryAfter is marked transient and retried by retryPublication (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:12-16), so retries do not stop immediately.

requirement: UTF-8 encoding uses the explicit utf8 encoding name.
Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, a suspended actor cannot plan any route.
finding: effectiveScopes keeps the scope of every active claim for a suspended actor (src/dispatch/access.mjs:5), and only the own scopes are dropped. Under dispatch-policy rule 5 a suspended actor has no held scopes. A suspended actor with an active routes:plan claim and a matching depot can therefore plan a route.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, delivery notices go to the contact phone of every manifest entry.
finding: sendDeliveryNotices passes entry.phone unchanged to sms.send (src/dispatch/publisher.mjs:31). Under dispatch-policy rule 33 an entry's contact phone is its phone with every space and hyphen removed, and manifestRecipients applies that normalization (src/dispatch/manifest.mjs:44), but delivery notices do not, so notices are addressed to the raw phone value.

requirement: Under docs/dispatch/dispatch-policy.md, the next retry delay follows the Retry timing rules whenever the server provides retryAfter.
finding: nextRetryDelay tests retryAfter for truthiness (src/dispatch/retry.mjs:24). A server-provided retryAfter of 0 is a finite numeric value, so under dispatch-policy rule 7 it must replace the computed backoff with the delay it gives (0 ms). The falsy test instead falls back to computeBackoff(attempt), so the server-provided value is not applied.
